lines.text: Is anyone going to fix that damn thing?!
lines.say: [annoyed, shouting up] Is anyone going to fix that damn thing?!

lines.text: That's a lifetime in Kattle years.
lines.say: [sighs] That's a lifetime in Kattle years.

lines.text: Eh… what do we have for dinner?
lines.say: [grumbling] Eh, what do we have for dinner?

lines.text: What? Like you've never farted in public?
lines.say: [defensive, annoyed] What? Like you've never farted in public?

lines.text: Heh. They think bars can hold me?
lines.say: [smug] Heh. They think bars can hold me?

lines.sfx: a single person whistling a short innocent nonchalant three-note tune, pretending nothing happened, dry

lines.text: Bonjour, Rusty! I bring news from ze Princess 'erself.
lines.say: [cheerful] Bonjour, Rusty! I bring news from ze Princess 'erself.

lines.text: Allez, allez! Ze sun is up, and so are you!
lines.say: [cheerful] Allez, allez! Ze sun is up, and so are you!
[groggy, annoyed] Ugh. Is that... the sun?

lines.text: Great. Now I'm gonna get a tan.
lines.say: [grumbling] Great. Now I'm gonna get a tan.

lines.text: Monsieur… zat is not a tan. Zat is rust.
lines.say: [dry, matter-of-fact] Monsieur... zat is not a tan. Zat is rust.

lines.text: Do you know what UV does to a vintage finish?
lines.say: [indignant] Do you know what UV does to a vintage finish?

lines.text: Of course, you will not be working alone.
lines.say: [cheerful] Of course, you will not be working alone.

lines.text: Ze Princess 'as assigned you… a supervisor.
lines.say: [proud, teasing] Ze Princess 'as assigned you... a supervisor.

lines.text: A supervisor? Let me guess — Boilbert? Lieutenant Leather?
lines.say: [smug] A supervisor? Let me guess... Boilbert? Lieutenant Leather?
[stern but cute] Woof! Bad kettle. Dukie watch.

lines.text: That mutt is the reason I'm in here!
lines.say: [annoyed] That mutt is the reason I'm in here!

lines.text: One: scrub ze soot in Steamtown.
lines.say: [reading a list] One: scrub ze soot in Steamtown.

lines.text: Two: fix ze fence in ze Cattle Valley.
lines.say: [reading a list] Two: fix ze fence in ze Cattle Valley.

lines.text: Three: light ze lanterns in ze Hybrid 'Ollow.
lines.say: [reading a list] Three: light ze lanterns in ze Hybrid 'Ollow.
[yelping in pain as he gets yanked] OWWWW!

lines.text: Mmm… zat is some good sheet.
lines.say: [sighs contentedly, relishing] Mmm... zat is some good sheet.
